data.description:
## Problem

The expedition PileView migration in Lost Cities (CG-0MQBOKB540040Q60) uses manual setTexture() calls (The Mind pattern) instead of the standard PileView.update() with cardTextureFn. This pattern works but duplicates texture-wiring logic across expedition colors.

## Goal

Once CG-0MQ6IFGP5001YJTQ or CG-0MQBOK2SQ0067ZBP delivers a unified custom-card texture resolution mechanism, refactor the Lost Cities expedition PileView instances to use the shared mechanism instead of manual setTexture().

This removes the last bespoke texture-wiring in the Lost Cities expedition PileView migration.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Expedition PileView instances in LostCitiesRenderer.refreshExpeditions() use PileView.update() with cardTextureFn (instead of manual setTexture + applyEnsuredTexture)
2. All cascade sprites remain managed manually (they show non-top cards, not handled by PileView)
3. Existing behaviour preserved (texture fallbacks, reduced-motion, animation compatibility)
4. Full test suite passes

## Dependencies

- CG-0MQ6IFGP5001YJTQ (blocking)
- CG-0MQBOK2SQ0067ZBP (blocking)

## Related

- discovered-from: CG-0MQBOKB540040Q60
- parent: CG-0MQ6IEM9F001JTQD
